reuse.why: Adds one guard that all five provider link handlers call, using the existing db helpers; it does not need anything the tree already had for this rule.

duplication.why: The 'already linked' query and error live in a single function; the five call sites only pass their provider name and ids.

placement.why: Correct server layer, though the tree keeps shared link helpers (findOrCreateBank) in accounts/link.ts and the guard was put in app.ts instead.

scope.why: Only the guard, its five calls at the top of each link handler, and tests.

maintainability.why: Small, well-named single definition placed before any side effects in every handler, easy to extend to new providers.

bypasses_abstraction.where: every provider link handler goes through ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked

one_place.where: ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked in server/accounts/app.ts, called by linkGoCardlessAccount, linkSimpleFinAccount, linkPluggyAiAccount, linkAkahuAccount and linkEnableBankingAccount
